name: Self-order tablet menu screen
describe: TabletLayout menu at 1280x800: header (px-6 py-4, border-b, H1 20/600 "Table T12", "New Order" button px-3 py-2 rounded-md border), then a split body: main pane 68% (p-6: category chips, search, 4-column grid gap-4 of cards min-w-150 rounded-xl with h-32 images) and the persistent CartPanel 32% (border-s, p-4).

Use for a tablet handed to a customer or fixed at a table. Base capture is the cart-filled state. Currency is a typed slot. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
